points.description: States that a very large number of hidden layers causes overfitting / high variance: the model fits training data well (low training error) but does not generalise to new/unseen data (high test error).
points.partial_credit: Half if only says the model is complex or performs badly, without mentioning overfitting, variance or poor generalisation.

points.description: States another issue: training / backpropagation becomes slow (or computationally expensive, harder to train).
points.partial_credit: Half if only vaguely says it is more complex or costly, without saying training is slow.

rubric.notes: Full marks for naming overfitting (or high variance / poor generalisation) and slow training or backpropagation, in any wording. Give part marks for vague but relevant statements such as 'too complex' or 'takes more time'. Give no marks for unrelated or wrong issues; extra remarks do not cost marks.
